lines: This plan covers 3 days, starting today.
Shopping and cooking first thing in the morning, so it is ready by lunch.
One shop, on Friday: everything this plan asks for keeps until it is cooked.
The shared base is vegan: that is Lea's line, and they have their own box. The rest of the table keeps theirs.

preparations.title: Roast chicken thighs
preparations.method: Heat the oven to 200°C. Rub the chicken with oil and seasoning, roast until cooked through, cool promptly and portion into the named boxes.

preparations.title: Roast tofu
preparations.method: Press and cube the tofu, toss with oil and paprika, roast beside the chicken until browned, then cool and portion into the named boxes.

preparations.title: Cooked quinoa
preparations.method: Rinse the quinoa, simmer it in the water until tender, cool quickly and portion into the named boxes.

preparations.title: Roasted September vegetables
preparations.method: Chop the vegetables, toss with oil and roast until tender. Cool promptly and portion into the named boxes.

preparations.title: Egg muffins
preparations.method: For Anna's meal, use clean equipment and fresh oil. Chop the spinach and pepper, whisk with the eggs, bake the muffins first, close Anna's box, then wash the board, knife, pan and worktop before opening or portioning any other preparation; use a separate serving spoon.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Buy the fresh chicken and vegetables today or the day before. Make and close the egg-muffin boxes first on clean equipment, then wash the board, knife, pan and worktop and use fresh oil. Heat the oven, put in the chicken, tofu and vegetables, cook the quinoa while they roast, cool everything promptly, and portion it into the named boxes.
